description: This file contains mock distribution functions for use with the Abseil C++ library and Googletest framework. It defines mock classes and functions to simulate random distributions for testing purposes, including mock versions of uniform, Bernoulli, Beta, Exponential, Gaussian, LogUniform, Poisson, and Zipf distributions.
